details: This package is an empty placeholder that performs a network callback to a hardcoded IP address at install time. The published tarball contains only a package.json (no source files, README or license) whose preinstall lifecycle script runs a curl fetch of hxxps://159[.]223[.]131[.]130:8080, so installing the package issues an HTTP request to that address on port 8080 before any code of the consumer's project runs. Nothing is downloaded to disk and nothing is piped to a shell, so the payload is limited to the callback itself; no environment variables, tokens, credential files (.npmrc, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws) or other local data are read or sent in the request. The package provides no functionality, so the only observable purpose of the install hook is the call out to that endpoint.
